REAL CONTENT PASS (2026): association.bodyPlaceholder is a direct translation of the Association's own 'About us' text from taqa.org.sa and its 2025 presentation deck. association.statusPlaceholder now states the Association's real license number (1000609300, printed on every official document and the site header) — this was the one field explicitly flagged as sensitive and not to be invented; it's now a confirmed fact, not a guess, so it moved out of the dashed 'pending' treatment into a plain confirmed-fact callout (see about.njk). taqathon.bodyPlaceholder/missionPlaceholder/visionPlaceholder are sourced from taqa.org.sa's own 'هاكثون الطاقة' page (the program's stated goals) and the board-approved resolution for 'Taqathon 2' (the 5-year national-initiative framing). See PROGRESS.md for the full source-by-field breakdown. Field names still say 'Placeholder' for historical reasons (avoids touching about.njk's variable names) — the CONTENT is real, not a placeholder, except where still flagged missing.

association.heading: About the Association
association.bodyPlaceholder: Launched in Jeddah in 2024, the Energy Association for Sustainable Development works to raise community awareness of renewable energy, support national initiatives, and drive innovation in the energy sector. Scientific research is one of its top priorities, alongside instilling sustainable behaviors, building economic awareness across generations, and developing the capabilities of innovators.

taqathon.heading: About Taqathon
taqathon.bodyPlaceholder: Taqathon is a national energy hackathon that brings entrepreneurs and researchers together to develop innovative solutions for energy sustainability through workshops and technical competitions. "Taqathon 2" is a continuous national initiative, planned to run annually for five years as a platform for innovation in energy and sustainability.
taqathon.missionPlaceholder: To deliver innovative renewable-energy solutions, raise awareness of the energy sector's challenges, connect participants with experts, provide technical support, and encourage investment in energy innovation.
taqathon.visionPlaceholder: A continuous national initiative and annual platform for innovation in energy and sustainability, running for five years.
